map.工伤赔偿计算器 使用指南: Work Injury Compensation Calculator — User Guide
map.工伤赔偿计算器依据《工伤保险条例》按伤残等级、本人工资测算一次性伤残补助金等待遇: Work injury compensation calculator, per the 'Work-Related Injury Insurance Regulations', estimates lump-sum disability benefits by disability grade and personal wage—for injured workers' rights, HR accounting, and claim estimation.
map.一次性伤残补助金 = 伤残月数(1级27…10级7) × 本人工资; 1–4级伤: Lump-sum disability benefit = disability months (Grade 1: 27 … Grade 10: 7) × personal wage; Grade 1–4 disability allowance = personal wage × (90%/85%/80%/75%)
map.一次性伤残补助金按伤残等级对应月数（一级27个月递减至十级7个月）乘以本人工资；: The lump-sum disability benefit multiplies personal wage by the months per grade (Grade 1: 27 down to Grade 10: 7); Grades 1–4 keep the labor relation and leave the post, paid a monthly disability allowance (90% to 75% of personal wage); Grades 5–10 upon ending the relation may also receive lump-sum medical and employment subsidies (based on the region's prior-year average monthly wage, with months set locally).
map.职工被认定工伤并评定伤残等级后，测算一次性伤残补助金、伤残津贴等。: After a worker is recognized as injured and graded, estimate lump-sum benefits, allowances, etc.
map.一至四级保留劳动关系、退出岗位，按月发伤残津贴（90%–75% 本人工资）。: Grades 1–4 keep the relation and leave the post, paid a monthly allowance (90%–75% of personal wage).
map.五至十级解除/终止合同的，另算一次性医疗与就业补助金。: Grades 5–10 ending the contract also get lump-sum medical and employment subsidies.
map.：一次性伤残补助金 = 11 个月本人工资（八级对应 11 个月）；本人工资 8: : Lump-sum benefit = 11 months of personal wage (Grade 8 = 11 months); wage 8000 CNY → 8000 × 11 = 88,000 CNY (plus medical/employment subsidies, etc.).
map.：一至四级按月发伤残津贴，一级为本人工资 90%；工资 8000 → 7200: : Grades 1–4 paid monthly; Grade 1 is 90% of personal wage; wage 8000 → 7200 CNY/month, switching to pension after retirement.

map.一次性伤残补助金月数怎么定？: How are the lump-sum benefit months set?
map.一级 27 个月递减至十级 7 个月；具体月数按《工伤保险条例》对应伤残等级确定: Grade 1: 27 months down to Grade 10: 7 months; the exact months follow the disability grade per the 'Work-Related Injury Insurance Regulations'.
map.没签合同能认定工伤吗？: Can injury be recognized without a contract?
map.能，存在事实劳动关系即可申请工伤认定，需工资流水、考勤、同事证言等证明劳动关系。: Yes—a de facto labor relation suffices to apply; prove it with pay records, attendance, and colleague testimony.
